comment: C ref: options.c:5425 update_rest_on_space() on an in-game toggle, initoptions_finish():7364 and restore.c restgamestate():571. Both segments use one rc that never mentions rest_on_space. Segment 0 turns the option on from #optionsfull, rests with <space>, and saves. Segment 1 restores: flags.rest_on_space is on in the save, but the new process bound <space> from the rc's default before the restore, so <space> is "Unknown command ' '." until the option is toggled again. Seeds, clock, character and keys chosen independently.
